Smoky Chicken & Wedges🍗🔥

Macros Per Serving (4 Total)

498 Calories | 47g Protein | 45g Carbs | 12g Fat

Ingredients (Serves 4)

Smoky Chicken
- 900g Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast, trim any fat
- 2 Tsp Garam Masala (salt included)
- 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika
- 1.5 Tsp Coriander Powder
- 70g Fat Free Yogurt
- 3/4 Lime Juice

• Spread the chicken on a lined tray and bake for 20 mins at 200C / 400F
• Rest for 5 minutes before slicing

Potato Wedges
- 800g Uncooked Red or Yellow Potatoes, cut into wedges
- 1 Tsp Garlic Powder
- Olive Oil Spray
- Salt to taste after cooking

• Season with garlic powder only, then air fry for 20-25 mins until crispy

Quick Slaw
- 200-300g Red Cabbage, thinly sliced
- 1/2 Tsp each Salt & Pepper
- 60g Light Mayo

• Make the slaw a day ahead, store separately
